mapper.insert: INSERT INTO petcare.menu (nombre, descripcion, icono, url, orden, activo) VALUES (#{nombre}, #{descripcion}, #{icono}, #{url}, #{orden}, #{activo})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM petcare.menu m WHERE m.deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE petcare.menu SET nombre = #{nombre}, descripcion = #{descripcion}, icono = #{icono}, url = #{url}, orden = #{orden}, activo = #{activo}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE petcare.menu SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.nombre, m.descripcion, m.icono, m.url, m.orden, m.activo, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.deleted, m.version FROM petcare.menu m INNER JOIN petcare.submenu sm ON sm.menu_id = m.id AND sm.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN petcare.permiso p ON p.menu_id = m.id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.rol_id = #{rolId} AND m.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.orden ASC
